post.description:
Login user with Supabase.

Args:
    request: Login request with email and password
    supabase_auth: Supabase authentication service

    Login response with JWT token

get.description:
List all API keys for the authenticated user.

Args:
    current_user: Current user from JWT token
    api_key_auth: API key authentication service
    
Returns:
    List of API key information (without secrets)

schema.title: Response List Api Keys Admin Api V1 Auth Auth Api Keys Get

post.description:
Create a new API key for the authenticated user.

Args:
    request: API key creation request
    current_user: Current user from JWT token
    api_key_auth: API key authentication service
    
Returns:
    API key response with secret key (only shown once)

delete.description:
Revoke an API key.

Args:
    key_id: API key ID to revoke
    current_user: Current user from JWT token
    api_key_auth: API key authentication service
    
Returns:
    Success message

get.description:
Get current user information.

Args:
    current_user: Current user from JWT token
    api_key_auth: API key authentication service
    
Returns:
    User information
